title: Proposed additive data payload for omp-kit next --role worker|director --json
description: Recommendation only, not an implemented or runtime-verified API. Retain the existing ok/tool_version/data/meta/warnings/commands/errors outer envelope. next is read-only and never claims, dispatches, commits, pushes or closes work.
x-exit-contract: 0 = structurally valid recommendation response, including absent/failed optional adapters reported UNKNOWN; 2 = invalid role/arguments under existing usage contract; existing internal/unavailable errors retained for core failures. UNKNOWN is never proof of readiness.
x-station-selection: Use evidence-backed ordered prerequisites per role. Missing adapter evidence cannot advance an agent past preflight, verify or adoption. Return UNKNOWN and explicit missing evidence rather than selecting a successful station from absent data. Emit exact argv only for executable commands; mark unresolved inputs explicitly, never fabricate bead IDs or paths.
x-portability: Stock runner without br, Tern, Agent Mail or cc must return exit 0, all four adapters UNKNOWN, and safe native discovery commands. Optional adapters are bounded read-only observations, not runtime dependencies. Do not shell out to a mutating workflow while collecting next. No home-directory or fleet-host assumptions.
